text_normalization: newlines-only/1 for UTF8; docling-text-provenance-page-view/1 for PDF; original OOXML paragraph text for DOCX
pdf_text_basis: Versioned native Docling TextItem.text/ProvenanceItem.charspan and table cell.text; not equality against pypdf or a claim of universal PDF Unicode order. orig is retained separately. Invalid spans remain missing_ranges/partial.
pdf_open_action_policy: Only current-document indirect page destinations /Fit or /FitB; optional GoTo dictionary has only S/D/Type; no Next chain; no action execution. This is an explicit S04 refinement of S02 blanket OpenAction rejection.
resource_mechanism: Linux cgroup v2 memory/swap/CPU/pids; default Docker seccomp plus libseccomp no-process/exec filter; parent remaining wallclock
security_scope: Nonroot read-only image; no network; one input file read-only, isolated owned output; model cache read-only; no DB/model secrets. Trusted developer orchestrator has Docker control and is never the product API.
